overview: Coraline is a 2009 American stop-motion animated Gothic dark fantasy horror film written, directed, and co-produced by Henry Selick and based on the 2002 novella by Neil Gaiman. It stars the voices of Dakota Fanning, Teri Hatcher, Jennifer Saunders, Dawn French, and Ian McShane. The film tells the story of a young girl discovering an idealized alternate universe behind a secret door in her new home, unaware that it contains something dark and sinister.
